svg.title: AI Visibility Is Not a Customer Conversion Rate
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-ai-visibility-and-qualified-demand; chapter number: 6; title: AI Visibility Is Not a Customer Conversion Rate; subtitle: Keep prompt coverage, citations, observation time, engine coverage, and qualified demos distinct.; caption: E-commerce Berlin Expo reports a citation experiment; TOP Digital Products describes engine coverage; Rob Hoffman reports qualified demos from comparison pages.; assumptions note: E-commerce Berlin Expo, TOP Digital Products, and Rob Hoffman describe different measurements and operations. These are independent checkpoints, not a decreasing cohort funnel; no stage-to-stage conversion rate is established.; note: The E-commerce Berlin Expo presenters continued testing citation durability. Rob Hoffman's roughly ten weekly qualified demos must not be attributed to their citation test or to the tool covered by TOP Digital Products.; chart type: funnel; stages: label: Tracked prompt panel; value: 143; display: 143 prompts; conversion: Not a conversion rate; detail: E-commerce Berlin Expo describes a panel of 143 prompts for the external-source citation experiment.; label: External-source citations; value: 800; display: Approximately 800 citations; conversion: Citations are not unique prospects; detail: E-commerce Berlin Expo reports approximately 800 citations after placing content on a domain not previously used as a source for the panel.; label: Initial observation interval; value: 5; display: 5 days; conversion: Elapsed time, not cohort attrition; detail: E-commerce Berlin Expo reports the initial citation result after five days, with durability still under examination.; label: AI engine coverage; value: 17; display: 17 AI engines; conversion: Separate tool coverage measure; detail: TOP Digital Products describes ZeroRank visibility tracking across seventeen AI engines.; label: Qualified demo outcome; value: 10; display: Roughly 10 qualified demos weekly; conversion: Separate comparison-page outcome; detail: Rob Hoffman reports this weekly result for Team Town comparison pages and says the team uses GA4 to track performance.

rect.title: label: Tracked prompt panel; value: 143; display: 143 prompts; conversion: Not a conversion rate; detail: E-commerce Berlin Expo describes a panel of 143 prompts for the external-source citation experiment.

label: External-source citations; value: 800; display: Approximately 800 citations; conversion: Citations are not unique prospects; detail: E-commerce Berlin Expo reports approximately 800 citations after placing content on a domain not previously used as a source for the panel.

label: Initial observation interval; value: 5; display: 5 days; conversion: Elapsed time, not cohort attrition; detail: E-commerce Berlin Expo reports the initial citation result after five days, with durability still under examination.

label: AI engine coverage; value: 17; display: 17 AI engines; conversion: Separate tool coverage measure; detail: TOP Digital Products describes ZeroRank visibility tracking across seventeen AI engines.

label: Qualified demo outcome; value: 10; display: Roughly 10 qualified demos weekly; conversion: Separate comparison-page outcome; detail: Rob Hoffman reports this weekly result for Team Town comparison pages and says the team uses GA4 to track performance.

text.title: Assumptions: E-commerce Berlin Expo, TOP Digital Products, and Rob Hoffman describe different measurements and operations. These are independent checkpoints, not a decreasing cohort funnel; no stage-to-stage conversion rate is established.
